title: uuencoding-multi/reassemble.rs and toc.rs: public types missing PartialEq, Clone, Eq
description:
Why this exists: uuencoding_multi/src/reassemble.rs defines ReassembledFile with #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)] but not Eq. uuencoding_multi/src/toc.rs defines TocEntry with #[derive(Debug, PartialEq)] (missing Clone and Eq) and ParsedToc with #[derive(Debug)] only (missing Clone, PartialEq, Eq).

What goes wrong: ReassembledFile has all Eq-eligible fields (String, u32, Vec<u8>, bool, Vec<u32>) — deriving PartialEq without Eq is misleading. TocEntry missing Clone means a collection of TocEntry values cannot be cloned. ParsedToc missing PartialEq prevents assert_eq! in tests. The inconsistency forces callers to work around the missing derives.

Location: uuencoding-multi/src/reassemble.rs (ReassembledFile), uuencoding-multi/src/toc.rs (TocEntry, ParsedToc).

Fix: add Eq to ReassembledFile; add Clone, Eq to TocEntry; add Clone, PartialEq, Eq to ParsedToc.
